red_tests.failure_fingerprint: test_rotated_refresh_token_is_persisted failed with 'assert [] == [(rotated-new, pphothidaen/HoroConsultant)]' after the persist call was replaced with a no-op, and test_workflow_refreshes_token_before_use failed with 'refresh must run before the Jira query' after the Refresh TWG access token step was removed from orchestrator-dispatch.yml. Both confirm the tests fail when the behaviour they pin is removed.

rationale: KAN-264: Atlassian forces rotating refresh tokens on new 3LO integrations, so the TWG access token expires in ~8h. GitHub runners are ephemeral, so twg auth refresh has no stored credentials to refresh and the refresh_token grant has to run in the workflow. The rotated refresh_token must be written back to the repository secret or every later run starts from a token Atlassian has already invalidated. Unconfigured runs exit 0 so provisioning delay cannot raise an SLO breach. Squash-merge re-anchor: PR #128 landed as squash commit e9b6c2be, so baseline_parent is re-anchored to that commit and test digests re-pinned to the merged content (KAN-260 precedent). The original tests/test_refresh_twg_token.py was renamed to tests/test_refresh_jira_token.py by the same PR, so the pin follows the renamed file.
